name: content-snare
description: Create requests, look up clients, review answers and manage your Content Snare account from Claude.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your Content Snare account through the Content Snare API. Ask Claude to send a request from a template, build a new request with its own questions, find a client, approve answers, or manage team members and webhooks.

You need a Content Snare personal access token. In Content Snare, go to **Settings > Security > Personal Access Tokens**, click **Generate access token**, tick the permissions you want Claude to have, and copy the token. Paste it into this extension's settings, never into a chat.

API access depends on your Content Snare plan. Questions: support@contentsnare.com.

api_token.title: Content Snare personal access token
api_token.description: In Content Snare: Settings > Security > Personal Access Tokens > Generate access token. It starts with cs_pat_. Leave blank to add it later under Settings > Extensions.
